delete.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete.subpages_one: Its subpage will be deleted with it.

delete.description: It’s removed for everyone in this Space, and links to it say it was deleted. Conversations about it stay in your chats.

move.title: Move “{{title}}”
move.description: It goes to the top of the Space you pick. Its history goes with it, and links to it keep working.
move.description-subpages_one: It goes to the top of the Space you pick, with its subpage. Its history goes with it, and links to it keep working.
move.description-subpages_other: It goes to the top of the Space you pick, with its {{count}} subpages. Its history goes with it, and links to it keep working.
move.none: There is no other Space to move it to.
move.save-first: Your latest changes could not be saved. Save them, then move the page.
